about.heading: Philosophy & Approach
paragraphs: I believe technology leadership is about more than writing code — it is about designing systems that empower people and organisations to move faster with confidence.

My journey from software developer to systems architect taught me that the best solutions emerge at the intersection of deep technical knowledge and clear strategic thinking. I approach every challenge by first understanding the business context, then designing systems that are resilient, maintainable, and built for growth.

I am passionate about mentoring engineers, fostering engineering cultures rooted in ownership and craftsmanship, and translating complex technical decisions into business outcomes that stakeholders can rally behind.

quote.text: Architecture is the art of making technical decisions that remain relevant long after the context has changed.
